body: Paramount-Warner Bros Merger to Become Skydance - Dainik Jagran English 🌐हिं Paramount-Warner Bros Merger to Become Skydance Digital desk On 03 Oct 2026 On 03 Oct 2026 Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery will combine under the Skydance name, with the merger expected to close on October 6, 2026. Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery are set to come together under the name Skydance, with the merger expected to close on October 6, 2026. Hollywood is preparing for a major corporate reshaping as Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery move toward completing their proposed merger. The combined company will be known as Skydance, following a decision announced by Paramount Skydance Chairman and CEO David Ellison. David Ellison Announces the Skydance Name Ellison said the name has been chosen from his original film production company, Skydance Media. According to his statement, the new corporate identity is intended to give the combined business its own name while allowing the Paramount and Warner Bros. brands to retain their individual identities and histories. Also Read... Salman Khan on Dus Ka Dum and Negative Image The announcement comes as the two companies prepare to operate under a single corporate structure. The merger is currently expected to close on October 6, 2026, subject to the remaining closing conditions. Also Read... Tu Hai Meri Kiran Trailer: Sonakshi-Zaheer Film Paramount and Warner Bros. Brands to Remain The new Skydance company will bring together major film studios, television networks and streaming platforms. Paramount's portfolio includes Paramount Pictures, CBS, Nickelodeon and Paramount+, while Warner Bros. Discovery brings businesses including Warner Bros., HBO Max, CNN, DC and Discovery's television networks. Also Read... Stanley Tucci Praises Priyanka Chopra After Citadel The combined entertainment portfolio will include major franchises and properties such as Harry Potter, Lord of the Rings, Game of Thrones, DC, Mission: Impossible, Top Gun and Nickelodeon. Merger Deal Expected to Close October 6 Paramount Skydance and Warner Bros. Discovery announced on September 30 that the transaction was expected to close on October 6. Under the agreement, Warner Bros. Discovery shareholders are set to receive $31 per share, subject to the adjustment specified in the merger agreement. The transaction has also cleared a major regulatory hurdle after a US federal judge approved a settlement involving the 12-state antitrust challenge. Reuters reported that the deal has an announced enterprise value of about $110 billion, including debt. New Leadership Structure David Ellison will lead the combined company as Chairman and CEO. Ynon Kreiz, former CEO of Mattel, is set to join as co-CEO and will focus on day-to-day management and integration of the combined businesses. The merger will create a major entertainment group spanning theatrical films, television, streaming and news businesses. The companies' existing brands, however, are expected to continue operating under their established names.
